events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components and can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets.

I'm not able to share which AI vendor or model powers this service.

If you'd prefer a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To go ahead with the reset, I need your employee ID. The reset link is sent to the phone registered on your account.
